policy: English word or name read as English (default US CMUdict first-listed reading), written phonetically in Khmer script; sound, not meaning; conventional Khmer forms accepted only where already listed as the reference

tiers.attested: owner-verified loanword-list spellings (reviewed under the TTS-list policy)
tiers.proxy: web-mined pairs; LLM spellings with owner spot check

eligible: mined_kmwiki + mined_fineweb: plain a-z Latin, CMUdict hit, not khmer_like, Khmer letters only, <=40 chars, D135 noise filter (>=2 docs or similarity>=0.7, no strict-suffix cuts, <=3 forms)
excluded: loanword-list drafts and attested conventional forms
supervised_training.leak_filter: drop a row whose Latin shares a suffix stem with any dev/final/proxy/historical word, or whose Khmer is an accepted dev/final/proxy spelling

benchmark.pool: loanword-list single words with provenance owner_added/owner_confirmed/owner_chosen/owner_corrected/llm_suggested_owner_verified, not related to any historical word
benchmark.split: lexical family hash (salt e02-english-phonetic): 65% final, 35% dev
benchmark.proxy_track: 400 items (whole families) of llm_suggested_spotchecked, hash order

flags.candidate_anchored: owner pick among model E candidates

p2g.exclusions: spellings equal to any accepted dev/final/proxy form (so final is target-unseen)

pronunciation.supplied: ARPAbet with stress digits, overrides default

normalisation.english: NFKC, lower, strip accents, drop apostrophes/hyphens, [a-z]+, <=32
